name: Gateway of India & Colaba Harbor
description: Mumbai's most iconic 26-meter arch monument built in 1924 overlooking the Arabian Sea, right opposite the historic Taj Mahal Palace Hotel.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT)
bestTimeToVisit: Evening when illuminated with dynamic lights
description: A UNESCO World Heritage site representing Victorian Gothic Revival architecture blended with traditional Indian Mughal accents.

name: Marine Drive & Girgaon Chowpatty
bestTimeToVisit: 5:30 PM - 9:00 PM for the Queen's Necklace view
description: A 3.6 km C-shaped coastal boulevard along the Arabian Sea coast, famous for sea breeze, street food at Chowpatty, and sunset walks.

name: Elephanta Caves
description: UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut cave temples dedicated to Lord Shiva dating between the 5th and 7th centuries. Requires a 1-hour scenic ferry ride from Gateway.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (CSMVS Museum)
description: Formerly known as the Prince of Wales Museum, featuring 50,000+ artifacts spanning ancient Indus Valley relics, Tibetan arts, and miniature Mughal paintings.

name: Haji Ali Dargah
description: 15th-century Indo-Islamic shrine and mosque situated on an offshore islet 500 meters from the coast, connected by a narrow causeway submerged during high tide.

name: Hanging Gardens & Kamala Nehru Park
bestTimeToVisit: Morning or 5:00 PM for Marine Drive viewpoint
description: Terraced hilltop gardens offering manicured hedges carved in animal shapes and panoramic sunset vistas overlooking Marine Drive and Back Bay.

name: Colaba Causeway & Regal Circle
description: Mumbai's famous street market corridor buzzing with antique shops, bohemian jewelry stalls, book vendors, and heritage hangouts like Cafe Mondegar and Leopold Cafe.

name: Shree Siddhivinayak Temple
description: One of India's most venerated temples dedicated to Lord Ganesha, founded in 1801, visited by thousands of pilgrims and celebrities daily.

name: Dhobi Ghat
description: The world's largest open-air human laundry, established in 1890, where hundreds of washermen clean hotel linens and garments in concrete washing pens.

name: Bandra Bandstand & Mount Mary Basilica
bestTimeToVisit: Late afternoon to catch sunset by the Portuguese Fort
description: Scenic rocky seafront walkway featuring Bollywood superstar bungalows (Shah Rukh Khan's Mannat, Salman Khan's Galaxy), Castella de Aguada fort ruins, and the historic Mount Mary Church.

name: Bandra-Worli Sea Link
bestTimeToVisit: Night drive when lit with blue cable lights
description: A 5.6 km 8-lane cable-stayed bridge spanning Mahim Bay that revolutionized Mumbai transit and became a modern engineering marvel and skyline symbol.

name: Juhu Beach & Street Food Lane
description: Mumbai's most happening suburban shoreline known for carnival vibes, horse rides, and iconic Mumbai chaat stalls serving Pav Bhaji, Sev Puri, and Kulfi.

name: Kanheri Caves
description: 109 rock-cut Buddhist prayer halls and monastic cells carved out of basaltic hills dating from the 1st century BCE to the 10th century CE.

name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park (SGNP)
description: A rare 104 sq. km protected tropical rainforest sanctuary nestled within city limits, home to wild leopards, deer, toy train safari, and boating lake.

name: Global Vipassana Pagoda
bestTimeToVisit: Morning or late afternoon via Gorai ferry
description: The world's largest stone dome built without supporting pillars, modeled after the Shwedagon Pagoda in Yangon, radiating peaceful meditation vibes.

name: ISKCON Temple Juhu (Sri Sri Radha Rasabihari)
bestTimeToVisit: 7:00 PM Evening Aarti followed by Govinda restaurant meal
description: A peaceful marble temple sanctuary spread over 4 acres offering spiritual solace, kirtan chants, lush courtyard, and acclaimed vegetarian prasadam.

name: Kala Ghoda Art Precinct
description: Mumbai's premier bohemian heritage art district dotted with premier galleries (Jehangir Art Gallery, National Gallery of Modern Art), designer boutiques, and street artists.

name: Nehru Science Centre & Planetarium
description: India's largest interactive science center with 500+ hands-on science exhibits, 3D dome science shows, and a dedicated astronomy planetarium.

name: Versova Beach & Rock Beach
description: A historic Koli fishing enclave and expansive sandy shoreline revived through community cleanups, famous for quiet sunsets and rustic fish markets.

name: Upvan Lake & Yeoor Hills
bestTimeToVisit: Evening for the illuminated walking promenade
description: Picturesque lake situated against the scenic backdrop of the Yeoor Hills forest, host to the famous Thane Arts Festival and scenic waterfront walkways.

name: Kharghar Hills & Central Park
description: One of Asia's largest urban recreational parks featuring sprawling botanical gardens, amphitheater, walking trails, and driving trails up Kharghar Valley.

name: Dadar Flower Market (Phool Galli)
description: A kaleidoscopic, high-energy wholesale morning market bursting with marigolds, roses, jasmine, and lotus transported from across Maharashtra.

name: Babulnath Temple
bestTimeToVisit: Morning, combine with Chowpatty or Hanging Gardens
description: An ancient 12th-century Shiva temple perched on a small hillock near Girgaon Chowpatty, accessed via stairs or elevator.

name: Carter Road Promenade
description: A 1-kilometer seaside promenade popular among jogger crowds, pet lovers, and foodies lined with artisanal cafes, ice-cream parlors, and sea views.
